basic_details.job_title: JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 72 Draftsman, Library Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB)
basic_details.short_information: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has released Advertisement Notification No. 07 of 2026, dated 08.07.2026, inviting online applications for Divisional Cadre posts across different departments. These posts are requisitioned under the PM Package for Kashmiri Migrants and Non-Migrant Kashmiri Pandits, based on an indent from the Disaster Management, Relief, Rehabilitation & Reconstruction (DMRRR) Department.

important_dates.date & centre of examination: Not specified in the official notification; to be notified separately on www.jkssb.nic.in

application_fee.details: Fee can be paid only through online mode - Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, and no representation against such rejection will be entertained. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

age_limit.details: Age is reckoned as on 01.01.2026. The maximum age limit and date-of-birth range vary by category, as detailed below.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Two years Draftsman Training Course Certificate/Diploma from any Government recognised Institute
Bachelor's Degree with Economics/Statistics/Mathematics/Commerce/Computer Applications/Information Technology as one of the elective subjects
Minimum qualification 10th with ITI Motor Mechanic Vehicle two-year course from a recognised institute; and a driving license for Motor Cycle with Gear and Light Motor Vehicles
Bachelor's degree in Library Science from a recognised university
Graduate degree from any recognised university with a degree/diploma in Library Science
Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognised University or Board of Examination

qualification.details: This recruitment is restricted to a specific eligible group: only candidates who qualify as "Migrants" under SRO 412 of 2009, or as "Kashmiri Pandits" under SRO 425 of 2017, are eligible to apply. Migrant status is certified by the Relief and Rehabilitation Commissioner, J&K, while Kashmiri Pandit status is certified by the Deputy Commissioner of the concerned district. In addition, candidates must be domiciles of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir and possess a valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Competent Authority, valid on or before the cut-off date of 08.09.2026. | Candidates must produce original certificates as proof of the prescribed qualification at the time of Document Verification, acquired strictly on or before the cut-off date. Candidates claiming an equivalent qualification must produce an Equivalence Certificate from the competent authority when required by the Board.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted in online mode only; no other means of application will be accepted. Detailed instructions and the Online Portal link will be made available separately on the JKSSB website.
Visit the official JKSSB website: www.jkssb.nic.in
Locate the online application link for Advertisement Notification No. 07 of 2026.
Register and fill in the online application form carefully, providing Name, Date of Birth, Father's Name, and Mother's Name exactly as per the Matriculation Certificate.
Upload the required documents: live photograph, signature (10 KB–20 KB), Category Certificate (max 100 KB, PDF), and Qualification/Experience certificates (self-attested, max 100 KB, PDF).
Pay the application fee online (Rs. 600, or Rs. 500 for SC/ST-1/ST-2/EWS/PwBD) via Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.
Review all entries carefully before final submission - no corrections are allowed after submission.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and retain it for Document Verification; do not submit hard copies to the JKSSB office by post or in person.

In-service candidates must additionally submit a printout of the filled application, along with a duly signed and stamped certificate, through proper channel (Head of Department) to the Office of the Secretary, JKSSB, by the last date of Document Verification.
important_instructions: Candidates are advised to submit online applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute portal load issues. Only one online application is allowed per Item Number; multiple applications for the same item may lead to cancellation and debarment. No request for change/correction in submitted application particulars will be entertained under any circumstances. Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected summarily. Mobile phones, smart watches, AI-enabled devices, and other electronic/communication devices are strictly prohibited during the examination. Candidates must carry two recent passport-size colour photographs and a valid original photo ID to the examination venue, failing which they will not be permitted to appear. No TA/DA will be paid for participation in the written test or Document Verification. The decision of the Board on eligibility, selection mode, results, and debarment is final and binding.

content_sections.text: This recruitment is restricted to a specific eligible group: only candidates who qualify as "Migrants" under SRO 412 of 2009, or as "Kashmiri Pandits" under SRO 425 of 2017, are eligible to apply. Migrant status is certified by the Relief and Rehabilitation Commissioner, J&K, while Kashmiri Pandit status is certified by the Deputy Commissioner of the concerned district. In addition, candidates must be domiciles of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir and possess a valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Competent Authority, valid on or before the cut-off date of 08.09.2026. Candidates must produce original certificates as proof of the prescribed qualification at the time of Document Verification, acquired strictly on or before the cut-off date. content_sections.heading: JKSSB Divisional Cadre Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for all 7 posts under this notification is made purely on the basis of merit obtained in the Written/OMR Examination, followed by Document Verification for shortlisted candidates. Written/OMR Examination: Objective type, Multiple Choice Questions, set in English language only. Negative marking of one-fourth (0.25) mark for each wrong answer applies. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates must appear with original documents - Domicile Certificate, Qualification Certificate, Category Certificate, Birth Certificate, Bonafide Certificate (if applicable), Migrant/Kashmiri Pandit status certificate - along with self-attested photocopies. Failure to appear or produce required documents on the scheduled DV date will result in the candidate not being considered for selection. The date and centre of examination, along with the syllabus, will be notified separately on www.jkssb.nic.in. Admit cards will be available for download about one week before the examination date.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Divisional Cadre Reservation and Horizontal Reservation
content_sections.text: Reservation is applied as per the category-wise break-up conveyed by the Indenting Department and the Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act/Rules. If candidates are not available from any reserved category (other than RBA), those posts may be filled from the Open Merit category. Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) is applicable as communicated by the Indenting Department; ESM horizontal reservation applies only to posts carrying pay up to Level-6E (35900-113500). An ESM candidate who avails Horizontal Reservation on joining a post cannot avail it again for subsequent employment.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Divisional Cadre Required Documents
content_sections.text: Domicile Certificate of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir, valid as on the cut-off date (08.09.2026). Migrant status certificate (SRO 412 of 2009) issued by the Relief and Rehabilitation Commissioner, J&K, OR Kashmiri Pandit status certificate (SRO 425 of 2017) issued by the Deputy Commissioner of the concerned district. Original educational qualification certificates as prescribed for the post applied for. Category/Reserved Category Certificate in the prescribed format, valid as on the cut-off date (if applicable). Ex-Servicemen Certificate in Form-XIV, duly signed by the competent authority (if applicable). Person with Disability Certificate, Certificate regarding Physical Limitation to Write (Annexure-B), and Letter of Undertaking for Using Own Scribe (Annexure-C), for PwBD candidates seeking scribe/compensatory time. Bonafide Certificate from the Controller/Registrar of the concerned University, for candidates with degrees from institutions outside the UT of J&K (other than Central Universities). Two recent passport-size colour photographs (not older than 6 months, with date mentioned) and an original valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card/e-Aadhaar printout, Voter ID, Driving License, PAN Card, Passport, or Institution/Employer ID Card).

faq.question: Q1. What is JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board under Advertisement Notification No. 07 of 2026 to fill 72 Divisional Cadre posts across 7 post names, reserved for Kashmiri Migrants and Non-Migrant Kashmiri Pandits under the PM Package.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 72 vacancies are available: Draftsman (Civil) – 1, Sub-Inspector – 39, Junior Statistical Assistant – 2, Motor Vehicle Traffic Assistant – 1, Junior Librarian – 10, Library Assistant – 5, and Depot Assistant – 14.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only candidates who qualify as "Migrants" under SRO 412 of 2009 or as "Kashmiri Pandits" under SRO 425 of 2017, and who hold a valid Domicile Certificate of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir, are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 08.09.2026. The application window opens on 10.08.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01.01.2026, the maximum age limit is 40 years for Open Merit candidates and 43 years for SC/ST-1/ST-2/RBA/ALC-IB/EWS/OBC candidates, and 42 years for PwBD candidates. See the age limit table above for the exact date-of-birth range for each category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600 for general candidates and Rs. 500 for SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS, and PwBD candidates, payable online only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based purely on merit obtained in a Written/OMR Examination (objective, English language, with negative marking of 0.25 for each wrong answer), followed by Document Verification for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification required for JKSSB Divisional Cadre posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Matriculation (Depot Assistant) to a Bachelor's Degree (Sub-Inspector, Junior Statistical Assistant, Junior Librarian, Library Assistant) or a specific diploma/ITI course (Draftsman Civil, MVTA). See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for JKSSB Divisional Cadre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online only through www.jkssb.nic.in, following the detailed application procedure to be published on the JKSSB website, and pay the applicable fee online.
